findings.title: ACP typed broker stream contradicted an overbroad no-capability statement
findings.closure: The threat model now distinguishes the managed ACP host's typed allowlisted stream from the complete absence of keys and broker capability in provider, model, MCP, shell and tool descendants.

findings.title: Frozen stdin transport lacked complete implementation and proof bindings
findings.closure: broker_transport_isolation now binds runtime, environment reservation, transport, ACP spawn, signing client and executable descendant proof paths; implementation and done conditions require stdin-only carriage, close-on-exec duplication, replacement child stdin, bootstrap scrubbing and negative argv, environment and open-descriptor probes.
